problem: What are the parametric equations of the hyperbola $6{y}^{2}-9{x}^{2}=36?$

feedback.problem: What are the parametric equations of the hyperbola $9{y}^{2}-{x}^{2}=36?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The parametric equations of a vertical hyperbola centered at the origin with Cartesian equation

$$
\frac{{y}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1
$$

are given by

$$
x=b\operatorname{tan}⁡t,\,y=a\operatorname{sec}⁡t.
$$

First, we rewrite the equation of our hyperbola in standard form, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}9{y}^{2}-{x}^{2} & =36 \\ \frac{9{y}^{2}}{36}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{36} & =\frac{36}{36} \\ \frac{{y}^{2}}{4}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{36} & =1\end{aligned}
$$

So, in our case, $a=\sqrt{4}=2$ and $b=\sqrt{36}=6.$ Therefore, the parametric equations are

$$
x=6\operatorname{tan}⁡t,\,y=2\operatorname{sec}⁡t.
$$
